https://ask.sciencemadereadable.com , #Ask Science, is a great quick, free search tool in displaying results compactly.                     

Put a question at the end of this address & get the scientific studies about it, as plain text:

    https://ask.sciencemadereadable.com/why do cats purr

(Spaces may be typed as they are, or as %20 or +.) About 200 million studies: titles & abstracts from OpenAlex,
searched by meaning. Quotes or AND / OR / NOT search for those exact words instead.

#research  #science  #humanties
